name: io.github.arminazimi/evergreen
title: Evergreen
description: Evidence-backed deprecation and end-of-life checks for dependencies, runtimes, and Actions.

tools.name: scan_repository
tools.description: Run all built-in Evergreen detectors against a local repository and return the complete versioned scan result.

tools.name: list_deprecations
tools.description: Run a fresh local scan and return a compact, versioned list of lifecycle findings.

tools.name: explain_deprecation
tools.description: Run a fresh local scan and return one complete evidence-backed finding by ID.

tools.name: create_migration_context
tools.description: Create a validated, rule-specific migration packet for one finding from a fresh local scan.

tools.name: verify_migration
tools.description: Re-scan locally and check whether a finding observed earlier in this MCP session is gone. Suggested project commands are returned but never executed.

tools.name: check_dependency
tools.description: Check one package, and optionally one version, against Evergreen's lifecycle rules before adding it. Pass a Package URL such as pkg:npm/request@2.88.2. no-data means Evergreen has no rule for the package, not that it is safe.

tools.name: forecast_repository
tools.description: Run a fresh local scan and list what reaches a dated end of life in the next months, grouped by month. Only events that carry an authoritative date are listed.
